project_info.theme: Dark floral fragrance hero for YSL Blouse
project_info.color_palette: Black, pale peach rose, blush amber glass, deep green stem

main_subject.detail: A YSL fragrance bottle stands upright on a reflective black base, labeled 'BLOUSE' and 'IMPERTINENT ROSE'. Large pale peach roses surround the bottle on the left while a thorny green stem rises diagonally behind it against a black background.
main_subject.style: Luxury fragrance hero packshot, dark floral still life, dramatic perfume advertising

items: Top Left: Large pale peach rose bloom lit dramatically against black
Top Right: Thorny green stem cutting diagonally across the dark background
Bottom Left: Additional rose petals and blooms framing the base of the bottle
Bottom Right: Reflective black surface mirroring the lower glass bottle
Center/Background: Transparent blush-toned YSL perfume bottle with black cap and black label reading 'BLOUSE' and 'IMPERTINENT ROSE'

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Hard directional highlights on glass, high-contrast floral shadows, rich black negative space, glossy reflection

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square luxury fragrance poster for YSL. Centerpiece is a transparent blush-toned YSL perfume bottle with a black textured cap and a black label reading 'BLOUSE' and 'IMPERTINENT ROSE', standing on a reflective black surface. Surround it with large pale peach roses on the left and a thorny green stem diagonally behind, all against a deep black background. Technical style: photoreal luxury fragrance photography, dramatic studio still-life lighting, hard glass highlights and glossy reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
